items.why: The interface configuration does not establish that cirub0 has no uplink or that the bastion is a chokepoint
Two bastion interfaces do not establish that all guest traffic must traverse the bastion
A forward-drop policy does not establish the claimed topology or GB10 exposure
The excerpt shows proxy networking but no SSH listener publication
The comment explicitly describes Docker-native isolation without host firewall changes
The hostname-to-SSH mapping does not establish Access enforcement or LAN reachability
The email allow policy does not establish where Access can be bypassed
The excerpt does not show the relay's published address or port
The SSH accept rule has no source restriction and explicitly includes LAN management
Forwarding options and tinyproxy settings do not establish SSH listener exposure
The configuration grants NVIDIA device access through persistent bind mounts and cgroup permissions
The boot and network settings do not establish GPU access or exclusivity enforcement
The window procedure manually stops production workloads and adjusts memory without revoking guest GPU access
The container inspection records a 20 GiB memory limit and unless-stopped restart policy
The launch command explicitly combines all GPUs with unless-stopped and a 20g memory limit
The diagram labels the GB10 container not yet built and provides no GPU enforcement evidence
The proxy has a bridge gateway and an additional cirubench network attachment
The Squid configuration explicitly denies destinations in the three RFC1918 ranges
The excerpt identifies the internal gateway but does not show proxy policy or probe coverage
The displayed LAN probes target <lan-address> rather than 172.30.99.1
The GB10 containers explicitly have restart policies contrary to the cloudflared-only assertion
The proxy explicitly has an unless-stopped restart policy
A fixed three-second sleep precedes container operations without a readiness check
The checks tolerate failures and label any failed TCP attempt blocked without the claimed validation
The isolation comment and shell options provide no validation results or false-pass checks
Access application settings do not establish whether validation was performed
The onboarding instructions do not establish the claimed validation failures or absence of recorded tests
The backup snapshot shows the exclusion value but no unlocked write
The proxy inspection shows no published-port mutation or locking behavior
The comment provides no evidence of unlocked writes to the three stores
GPU device permissions and mounts are unrelated to the claimed shared-store writes
The topology description provides no evidence of SDN mutations or locking
The script conditionally creates the network and removes existing named containers before recreation
The teardown procedure contains no step restarting production workloads
User permissions and proxy variables do not establish key installation or teardown completeness
User creation and SSH settings do not establish whether keys or email have been installed
The onboarding section treats receipt and installation of the email and SSH key as pending
